teaching_clarity.rationale: The Northline case gives typed authority states, standing, verification, capacity, capture, emergency expiry, remedy, withdrawal, and an evidence ceiling one causal arc. The visual never turns a packet into a legitimacy certificate.

composition.rationale: A stable institutional frame keeps jurisdiction, packet, affected public, verifier, remedy, and residuals in predictable spatial roles. The 31-beat animatic and caption sheet show chapter-specific diagrams rather than a generic card grid.

motion_quality.rationale: Arrows, branches, crosses, pauses, repair routes, expiry, and custody are purposeful state changes. Build states resolve into legible end states; no rejection mark or stale title frame leaks into the next beat.

synchronization.rationale: Thirty-one receipt-derived beat boundaries, 524.625 seconds of audio/video, and 116 exact receipt-derived caption cues agree. The plan audit passes story coverage and the AV audit reports matching duration with no black or silent intervals.

continuity.rationale: Northline, the institutional packet, typed ledgers, public standing, verifier challenge, remedy, withdrawal custody, and evidence ceiling recur with stable meanings from hook through handoff.

pacing.rationale: The 1045-word narration runs at 119.5 words per minute. Its 524.625-second runtime exceeds the preferred three-to-six-minute range deliberately so jurisdiction, representation, coordination, remedy, competition, withdrawal, and evidence limits are not collapsed; six minutes is a soft target.

voice.rationale: The narration is concrete and calm around Northline while precise about public authority, uncertainty, conflict, contest, and nonclaims. It distinguishes technical control from legitimacy and agreement from enforcement.

sound_mix.rationale: The muxed animatic uses the pinned 48 kilohertz narration and measures minus 16.4 LUFS integrated, 3.0 LU range, and minus 1.4 dBTP. Mechanical diagnostics report no silence or clipping.

engagement.rationale: The authority hook, governance substitutions, conflicted assessor, missing-standing repair, hidden settlement, executable remedy, withdrawal custody, and open responsibility question create a sustained reveal without pretending coordination is solved.

accessibility.rationale: Labels, position, enclosure, arrows, crosses, and line style duplicate color. All 116 captions pass exact timing and representative-frame review; the adjacent descriptive transcript names every material visual transition.

claim_fidelity.rationale: The film remains a design-rationale derivative of the synthetic Northline case. It does not promote a packet, treaty, tabletop, or finite record into proof of legal compliance, public trust, safety, stable alignment, AGI, or ASI.

non_claim: Passing animatic records a chapter-specific audiovisual teaching candidate only; picture-and-sound lock, release-candidate, independent release-candidate, publication, and book-evidence promotion remain ungranted. Rejected and superseded renders remain preserved in ignored build generation history.
